description: This file defines the lowest-level packet structure and associated functions for communication between host and guest in the confui module of the cuttlefish project. It includes functions for creating, reading, and writing payloads, as well as internal utilities for handling packet data.

methods.name: AppendToBuffer
methods.description: Appends variadic arguments to a buffer, used internally for constructing payloads.

methods.name: MakeSizeHeader
methods.description: Creates a vector of sizes for each argument, used in payload construction.

methods.name: ToPayload
methods.description: Constructs a Payload object from command string, session ID, and additional arguments.

methods.name: ReadPayload
methods.description: Reads a payload from a shared file descriptor, returning an optional ParsedPacket.

methods.name: WritePayload
methods.description: Writes a payload to a shared file descriptor, given command, session ID, and arguments.
